# kion_idms_open_id_access_rule (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion IdmsOpenIdAccessRule by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_idms_open_id_access_rule" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the IdmsOpenIdAccessRule to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `assertion_name` (String)
- `assertion_regex` (String)
- `cloudtamer_access_level_id` (Number)
